g.text: CRUDE CHARGE PUMPS & COLD PREHEAT TRAIN
1. Crude-side design pressure 30 barg (= PSV-1010 set) for P-101 discharge system to D-101A inlet.
2. Exchanger hot-side connections shown at channel / shell nozzles; TEMA type & shells per data sheets.
3. TV-1041 / TV-1004 bypass control valves have block valves only (exchanger provides bypass path).
4. Demulsifier dosed at P-101 suction, ratio to FIC-1001 (FFIC-1002) - X-101 vendor package.
5. Line numbers: <NPS>-<fluid>-<area>-<seq>-<class>-<insulation> per CONVENTIONS; see line list CFU-000-PI-LL-001.
6. All vents / drains 3/4" min. with blind or cap; HPV/LPD to piping specification. Valve sizes = line size UNO.
7. Instrument tags per ISA-5.1; index CFU-000-IC-IDX-001. SIS functions per SRS (SIF tags shown in interlocks).
